entities.name: Alfons Koziełł-Poklewski
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Alfons Koziełł-Poklewski was a Polish industrialist, social activist and real state councilor who became one of the richest entrepreneurs in Russian Siberia in the 19th century. Due to his success, he was known as the "vodka king of Siberia" and later called the "Siberian Rockefeller".
